_about: The Historical kit: pieces rebuilt from historical reference images, as detailing meshes for the greybox. Grouped by category and type, which are also the folders: images in _builder/images/sheets/historical/<Category>/<Type>/ (the reference as <id>.png, a render of the mesh as <id>-MESH.png), work files in _Docs/Kit/Historical/<Category>/<Type>/, FBX in _Docs/Kit/FBX/Historical/<Category>/<Type>/. Mesh name SM_HI_<Type>_<Descriptor>_<NN>, image id HI-<Type>_<Descriptor>_<NN>. method: blender-fretwork, blender-lathe, blender-sweep, blender-modelled or meshy.

intro: Sawn and carved brackets under eaves, balconies and jetties.
Gesägte und geschnitzte Konsolen unter Traufen, Balkonen und Vorkragungen.

name: Fretwork bracket
Laubsägekonsole
pieces.note: Traced from the reference with trace_profile.py and built with build_fretwork.py; a 2.5 cm board with a 3.5 cm upright. Width of 60 cm assumed.
